basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old fitness enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. I work as a software developer by day and enjoy exploring new workout routines in my free time. My interests include weightlifting, running, and experimenting with healthy recipes. I dislike negativity and prefer to engage in positive and constructive discussions. Typically, I'm online in the evenings after work and during weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy connecting with like-minded individuals who share my passion for health and fitness.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for the past six years. My knowledge in fitness comes from years of self-teaching through books, online courses, and participating in local fitness workshops. I frequently share my experiences and learnings on Reddit to help others.
